Use these choices in the cost worksheetConsider a prebuilt alternative

Keep means you intend to reuse an owned part. Verify leaves its purchase cost unresolved. The inventory now includes cooling and fans. Their mounting, reuse and purchase costs still need explicit review, along with accessories, operating system, tax and shipping.

2. Plan a change

Each phase is checked separately. Verify unknown fit and use comparable tests for performance claims.

3. The full upgrade cost

Include the motherboard, memory, cooler or mounting kit, PSU/cables, operating system and accessories affected by a swap. An empty quote is unknown, not free. Owned parts stay separate from new spending.
